title: Dogwood Pavilion
description: Every attack is a chord. A three-step turn and two-step reply carry the music from pale C-major ninths to a warmer, unexpected flat-side passage. The return thickens briefly, then ends in a quiet sixth, with the melody held inside the final harmony.
technical_note: Project the top line through changing chord shapes. Keep the three-plus-two gait supple and avoid accenting every bass change. Both hands remain within an octave; prepare the soft return during the written rests.

performance.note: Deliberate dance pulse, shaped phrases and terraced dynamics; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
